subject: Scientific Instruments Change - Southwestern Shore - Halifax Approaches
text:
Scientific Instruments Change - Southwestern Shore - Halifax Approaches
Wave Glider C34164NS is remotely offloading data from bottom-mounted Innovasea VR4-UWM acoustic receivers located along polyline:
44 23.815N 063 26.530W
44 28.707N 063 31.986W
Wave glider C34164NS is copper in colour with a mast extending 1.2 metres above the surface of the water, supporting a solid white light and orange visibility flag and is equipped with a non-transmitting AIS receiver.
It is remotely operated, moving at a speed of approximately 1.0 knots and measuring 3.05 metres by 0.81 metres.
For further information, authorities and mariners may contact Sue L’Orsa at 250-877-8052, Tyler Byrne at 902-719-7078, or Liquid Robotics Wave Glider Operations Centre at +1 888-574-4574 or 408-636-4205.
